headline: Cadence Design Systems SVP Paul Cunningham Sells 2,000 Shares for $767,000
summary: Cunningham maintains 125,586 direct shares valued at $46.66 million. Sale executed under Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted in March 2026, reflecting routine portfolio management.

headline: Synopsys (SNPS) Stock May Be 24% Below Fair Value On AI Design Tool News
summary: Synopsys stock has had a tough year, with a sharp share price decline sitting alongside a split valuation picture where the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate points to meaningful upside while market multiples suggest the stock is expensive. Over the past 12 months, Synopsys shares have declined 38.7%, which raises the question of whether recent weakness has opened a gap between price and underlying value. The integration of Ansys and ongoing investment in advanced semiconductor design...
